body:
Part of campaign #6812, P13. Maintainer/coordinator approved this bounded charter under the user's ALL instruction.

The plan says to pin proposal scope at creation (viewer-ai-plan.md139). Current Assistant parsers refuse selected/visible filter, list and lens populations, although Lists already support expressIdsByModel snapshots. Add one native captured-population contract across filter, List, manual Lens and auto-color Lens. Preserve existing all/model-rule behavior and chart scopes.

Scope and stopping point:
- Capture authoritative selected/visible entity refs once when preparing/opening the proposal; later selection/visibility changes affect only a deliberate re-capture. Reuse canonical selection, visible-set and entity-resolution services, including mutation-view allocated IDs and single-model fallback. ScopeControl supplies the existing count/capture UI pattern; it is not a resolver.
- Persist exact sourceFingerprint + expressId membership metadata in native saved configurations, with explicit captured scope/count caption. Runtime model IDs are resolved anew. Missing, duplicated/ambiguous or replaced source identity and missing/reused authored identities are unavailable, never broader all-model populations. Do not substitute presumed unique IFC GUIDs.
- Use the native Rules candidate interface with an explicit empty candidate set for every other loaded model. Reuse native Lists snapshot iteration and Lens providers for both rule selection and population/auto-color iteration. Intersect scope with native criteria rather than widening source-class semantics. Keep scene effects outside the captured population from changing it.
- Native editors support caption, clearing and deliberate re-capture; Save/Open/reload/backup retain the snapshot. Scope metadata is validated at library import/load boundaries; unsupported hosts refuse it rather than ignoring it.
- Assistant preview/save and opened native editor agree on the exact population and units/denominators. Review freshness binds model/edit identity without becoming a dynamic visible lens.

Acceptance on actual committed SketchUp and federated fixtures: selected/visible captures; later context change does not move a draft; source type/rule intersections; renderer/property selection channels; native hierarchy expansion explicitly disclosed; empty population never means all; independent A/B ID collisions; source ambiguity/removal/replacement/reload; mutation-created entities and identity reuse; native save/open/edit/clear/re-capture, native auto-color actions, storage/backup round trip; unrelated existing unscoped artifacts remain unchanged. Prove before/after user-visible native behavior and full-class reversion, then root turbo qualification.

One defect class, one issue; stack reviewable PRs against this issue if the implementation exceeds roughly1500 changed lines. No copied selection/visibility registry, no second IFC loading path, no changes to the already qualified editor7178 branch while awaiting its checks.

Human labels, fixture privacy/licence approvals and coordinator study remain pending #6928; this charter does not perform or invent them.

labels.name: ready
labels.description: Maintainer-approved: in scope, wanted now, scoped. A PR may close this.

title: P13: pin selected and visible populations in native saved artifacts
